title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements: Correcting Home Delivery Fees on Fleet Deals
content:
Under Kessler Automotive Group's **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, the home delivery fee on a **Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement** delivered beyond the free radius is the fleet home delivery fee. A home delivery fee posted on such a deal above that amount is corrected.

## Scope of the fleet home delivery fee

For a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement delivered by home delivery beyond the deal type's free home-delivery radius, this policy sets the home delivery fee, and only for such a deal. Every other deal type keeps its fee of the miles beyond the free radius times the deal type's home delivery per-mile rate, rounded to the cent and never less than the deal type's minimum home delivery fee. Every home delivery fee, this one included, is posted once per deal as the home delivery fee charge on the delivery date.

## Correction of a fee posted above the fleet home delivery fee

A home delivery fee found posted on such a fleet deal above the fleet home delivery fee is corrected by one charge reversal under the home delivery fee charge code for the excess, pointing at the posted fee charge. A fee posted at or below the fleet home delivery fee is left as posted.

| Posted fee on the fleet deal (net of any part already reversed) | Handling |
|---|---|
| Above the fleet home delivery fee | One reversal for the excess, pointing at the posted home delivery fee charge |
| Equal to the fleet home delivery fee | Left as posted; no reversal |
| Below the fleet home delivery fee | Left as posted; no reversal |

The original charge stays on the deal. The reversal is a separate entry, and the deal's balance due falls by the amount reversed.

## Invocation: `reverse_fleet_delivery_fee_7a0a59bd`

**Capability.** The tool reverses part of a home delivery fee charged on one fleet vehicle purchase deal. It books one charge reversal with charge code `home_delivery_fee` on the deal, dated the handling date and pointing at the home delivery fee charge it corrects. The deal's balance due drops by the amount reversed, and the original charge stays on the deal. The buyer sees the delivery-fee reversal on the deal statement and a lower balance due.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks `reverse_fleet_delivery_fee_7a0a59bd` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_deal_id` | The purchase deal identifier (deal reference number) of the delivered fleet deal, as returned by the purchase deal lookup for the verified customer | Identifier text |
| `source_txn_id` | The transaction identifier of the home delivery fee charge being corrected, as returned by the purchase transaction lookup; it must identify a home delivery fee charge of that same deal | Identifier text |
| `reversal_amount` | The part of the charge reversed | US dollars as a decimal number greater than zero with 2 decimal places (cents); further digits are rounded half up to the cent, and the rounded amount is what is booked |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a string that starts with "Delivery fee reversed". The string gives the reversal reference, the deal reference, the corrected charge reference, the charge code `home_delivery_fee`, the amount reversed (US dollars, 2 decimals), the reversal date (YYYY-MM-DD, the handling date) and the deal's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals).

A string that starts with "Error:" means nothing was booked. This happens when the amount was not greater than zero, or when the charge reference does not identify a home delivery fee charge of that deal.
